purpose: Independent-source scale-up pilot with class-disjoint held-out evaluation.

data.train: 256 relation audios from 40 classes, 1024 inverse-relation queries, plus 512 ordinary localization rehearsal queries
data.test: 40 class pairs from 10 classes never used in training, two independent source/layout replicates per pair, 320 inverse-relation queries
data.leakage_rule: No ESC-50 held-out class or source file may occur in training; SpotSound-Bench is not used for training or hyperparameter selection.

matched_runs: RBEE plus the same ordinary localization rehearsal
go_rule: Continue RBEE if it improves PairAcc@0.5 over matched SFT by at least 0.0625, or lowers Swap Error by at least 0.0625 without lowering query mIoU by more than 0.02.
stop_rule: If RBEE fails the independent held-out rule, retain the RelTwin data paradigm but reject the current exchange objective; do not tune on ESC-50 held-out classes.
future_guardrail: Only the selected fixed adapter will receive one 400-query SpotSound-Bench evaluation after the independent decision.
